Administration in renal impairment. Dosage of aztreonam should be reduced in moderate to severe renal impairment. Pa- tients with renal impairment may be given a usual initial dose followed by a maintenance dose adjusted according to creatinine clearance (CC): • CC 10 to 30 mL/minute: half the initial dose • CC less than 10 mL/minute: one-quarter of the initial dose • haemodialysis patients: a supplementary dose of one-eighth of the initial dose may be given after each dialysis session Preparations USP 31: Aztreonam for Injection; Aztreonam Injection.
